Date : 4th February, 2026.
Mrs. Vishakha Gadekar, Advocate submits that she has instructions to appear on behalf of the complainant and would be filing an application for permission to assist the prosecution 2.
Notice
returnable on 9th March, 2026.
3. Learned APP waives notice for respondent State.
4. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the entire allegations of paying the amount for getting employment to the son of the complainant is against the main accused Anil Sakla.
The applicant is a good friend of the main accused Anil Sakla and was present at the time of talks between the complainant and main accused Anil Sakla.
The applicant being a friend of Anil Sakla had executed the agreement and also handed over the post dated cheques to return back the amount to the complainant.

The co-accused Adam Khan who is also attributed the identical role of being friend of main accused Anil Sakla and was present at the time of handing over the amount of Rs. 10 Lakhs on 18.3.2019, is protected by granting anticipatory bail by the learned Sessions Judge vide order dated 17.1.2026.

The applicant's bail application came to be rejected only on the ground that the applicant has issued post dated Shaikh Mohammad Khaled Shaikh Mohammad ... vs The State Of Maharashtra on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16972437/
1 cheques to the complainant

sentences.text: The applicant is not having any criminal antecedents and is ready to abide by the conditions that may be imposed by this court.
Hence, the applicant may be protected.
6. Thus, taking into consideration above submissions, I am inclined to protect the applicants till the investigating papers are seen.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER [I] In the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with Crime No. 001 of 2026 registered with Daulatabad Police Station, District Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 r/w 34 of IPC the applicant Shaikh Mohammad Khaled Shaikh Mohammad Hanif be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-, with one or more sureties in the like amount, on the following conditions :-
[i] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station and report to the Investigating Officer on 9 th, 10th, 16th, 17th and 23rd and 24th February, 2026 between 11.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigation.
